claims: 25mg elemental iron as bisglycinate per capsule, adult one capsule daily preferably with meal or clinician directions.
Iron supports hemoglobin and oxygen transport. Fatigue alone does not establish iron deficiency.
Iron can cause GI upset; manufacturer non-constipating marketing is not amplified as guaranteed no side effects.
Keep away from children; overdose requires immediate medical attention. Consult clinician in pregnancy/nursing, medication use or conditions; avoid self-supplementation in iron overload.
